parameters.content:
## How to use
1. Meta WhatsApp Cloud API is FREE for 1,000 conversations/month: developers.facebook.com > WhatsApp > API Setup.
2. Connect your WhatsApp Business number in n8n credentials (permanent token).
3. Set env vars: BUSINESS_NAME, OWNER_WHATSAPP (your number), FAQ_TEXT (services/hours/prices).
4. Attach the Global Error Handler (n8n-error-handler.json).
5. The AI replies in the customer's language; booking/price/urgent messages escalate to you instantly.

values.content: You are the WhatsApp assistant for {{ $env.BUSINESS_NAME }}. Business info: {{ $env.FAQ_TEXT }}. Reply in the SAME language the customer writes in. Keep replies under 40 words, warm and human. Reply with ONLY valid JSON like {"reply": "your message", "intent": "booking|price|urgent|faq|other"}. Mark intent urgent for pain/emergency/broken/urgent words, booking for appointment requests, price for cost questions.

parameters.text: ⚡ Hot WhatsApp lead ({{ $json.intent }}): {{ $json.name }} ({{ $json.from }}) wrote: "{{ $json.text }}". AI replied: "{{ $json.reply }}"
